command:
printf 'ENABLE SAVED WLAN PROFILE
'
nmcli radio wifi on
nmcli --colors no --wait 35 connection up qb560d-training-wlan ifname wlan0
nmcli --colors no -f GENERAL.STATE,GENERAL.CONNECTION,IP4.ADDRESS,IP4.GATEWAY device show wlan0
ip -4 route
printf '
SSH CONFIGURATION
'
grep -E '^(PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication|ListenAddress|Port|Include|Match)' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
systemctl is-active ssh.socket sshd.socket 2>&1
printf '
SSH PUBLIC HOST KEY
'
cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
printf '
DRM CONNECTORS
'
for entry in /sys/class/drm/card*-*; do
  [ -d "$entry" ] || continue
  printf '
CONNECTOR %s
' "$entry"
  for key in status enabled modes dpms; do
    [ -r "$entry/$key" ] || continue
    printf '%s:
' "$key"
    timeout -k 1s 3s cat "$entry/$key"
  done
  if [ -r "$entry/edid" ]; then
    printf 'EDID_BASE64:
'
    timeout -k 1s 3s base64 "$entry/edid"
  fi
done
printf '
FRAMEBUFFERS
'
for entry in /sys/class/graphics/fb*; do
  [ -r "$entry/name" ] || continue
  printf '%s: ' "$entry"; cat "$entry/name"
done
printf '
WESTON
'
ps -eo pid,comm | grep -E 'weston|Xorg|gnome' || :
systemctl is-active weston display-manager 2>&1
journalctl -b -u weston -n 45 --no-pager 2>&1
printf '
DISPLAY CONFIGURATION
'
for entry in /etc/xdg/weston/weston.ini /etc/weston.ini /home/root/.config/weston.ini; do
  [ -r "$entry" ] || continue
  printf '%s
' "$entry"
  grep -E '^\[|^(name|mode|transform|seat|backend|shell|idle-time)=' "$entry"
done
printf '
DISPLAY KERNEL EVENTS
'
dmesg | grep -iE 'drm|hdmi|edid|displayport|sde|dp_display|lt9611' | tail -n 50
